summary: FOODbakēd Pass 2.5 — Live Driver Map on /foodbaked/orders/{orderId}/track. Verified map gating logic, 3 markers (restaurant/customer/driver), WS wiring to /api/express/ws/bookings/{booking_id}, FR/EN legend parity, mobile 390x844 viewport, pickup-order map hiding, and full backward compat with Pass 2 testids. Backend regression: 16/16 pass on test_food_dispatch_bridge.py + test_food_dispatch_bridge_pass2_ext.py (after seed-data repair, see action_items).

minor.issue: restaurant row had latitude=NULL, longitude=NULL which caused dispatch_bridge to raise 'restaurant_coords_missing' and silently kill all delivery dispatches (confirmed in backend.err.log). All 11 bridge tests were failing because of this one missing seed. Fixed in-DB (lat=5.3599517, lng=-4.0082563 — Abidjan). Main agent should persist this in the seed/migration so future environments don't regress.

action_items: Backfill food_restaurants.latitude/longitude for burger_hub_ci in the seed script (fixtures/seed_food.sql or equivalent). Current in-DB fix: 5.3599517, -4.0082563. Without it, dispatch_bridge raises restaurant_coords_missing on every preparing transition and the Live Driver Map feature never surfaces because no express_bookings row is created.
critical_code_review_comments: FoodOrderTrackPage.jsx L209: `showMap = GMAPS_KEY && pickup && drop && (driverAssigned || driverLoc)` — correct, verified live: (a) order without driver assigned → food-track-map ABSENT, driver chip + stages still render; (b) pickup order with order_type='pickup' and null delivery_address → food-track-map ABSENT regardless of status.

FoodOrderTrackPage.jsx L145-172: WS lifecycle good — `stopped` latch prevents racey reconnect, 3s reconnect timer, cleanup on unmount. The `onmessage` handler updates liveLoc from both `snapshot.driver_location` and `location.driver_location`.

FoodOrderTrackPage.jsx L248-251: Google Maps SDK logs a warning 'A Map's styles property cannot be set when a mapId is present. When a mapId is present, map styles are controlled via the cloud console' — harmless but noisy. Consider dropping the `styles={[...]}` prop when `mapId` is set, or moving POI hiding to a Cloud-console map style. Not a functional bug.

Backend untouched as advertised — /api/express/ws/bookings/{bid} returns an identical `snapshot` frame on both FOOD-delivery bookings (type:'snapshot', driver_location:{lat,lng} present) and legacy SEND bookings (type:'snapshot', extra keys driver_id + drop). SEND tracking UI /send/track/{bid} still renders its 'security token missing' guard page when no ?t= is passed — expected.

Realtime module logs 'realtime.pubsub redis unavailable — falling back to inproc' every startup. In-process pubsub works for same-process WS fanout (so tracking.transition_status → connected customer WS works), but across uvicorn workers it won't. Not a Pass 2.5 blocker since current deploy is single-worker, but worth tracking.

rca of the issue: Backend regression (seed-level, NOT code): food_restaurants.burger_hub_ci was persisted with latitude=NULL, longitude=NULL. dispatch_bridge.py L168-170 raises DispatchError('restaurant_coords_missing') when either is None, which the food.orders PATCH handler swallows into a WARN log and skips express_bookings creation. Downstream: no delivery row → delivery object = None on /api/food/customer/orders/{id}/track → FoodOrderTrackPage shows no map, no driver chip, breaks all 11 dispatch tests. Reproduction: UPDATE food_restaurants SET latitude=NULL, longitude=NULL WHERE id='burger_hub_ci'; pytest -q backend/tests/test_food_dispatch_bridge*.py — 11 fail. Mitigation: UPDATE food_restaurants SET latitude=5.3599517, longitude=-4.0082563 WHERE id='burger_hub_ci'; or add COALESCE in seed.
